name: Evidence-first company research with deterministic analytics and evaluation

global_policy.host_ownership: Actual prompt wording, model selection, and runtime implementation remain host-owned.
global_policy.portable_semantics: Stage roles, objectives, and completion criteria are portable execution semantics.
global_policy.tool_policy: Research tools must be read-only; deterministic calculators must be versioned; open-world retrieval must preserve source and timing receipts.
global_policy.credential_policy: Credentials remain host-owned and must not enter portable inputs, outputs, state, or artifacts.
global_policy.evidence_policy: Unavailable, denied, or unlicensed evidence must be represented explicitly.
global_policy.completion_policy: A stage must not report completion when its completion criteria are not satisfied.
global_policy.authority_policy: No stage grants broker, order-placement, or trading-execution authority.

full.description: Host uses native subagents, parallel tools, and structured output.

compatible.description: One host agent executes the same stages through the local sequential runner.

tools_only.description: A host MCP client owns execution and submits one completed bundle through the implemented coordination/import contract.

history_policy.latest_data: Retrieve through the requested cutoff and record exact availability.
history_policy.lookback: Use enough history to cover at least one business cycle when available; shorten or extend by pack and company history.
history_policy.prohibition: Never infer freshness or completeness from retrieval time alone.

stages.objective: Define a point-in-time research plan that maps the selected pack to evidence, analysis, and validation work.
completion_criteria: The plan identifies the requested cutoff, selected research pack, required evidence classes, and explicit source limitations.

stages.objective: Collect authoritative company disclosures available by the requested cutoff and preserve their availability metadata.
completion_criteria: Official-source documents or explicit unavailability records cover every planned official evidence class without silently substituting sources.

stages.objective: Collect point-in-time market history through the latest session actually available at the requested cutoff.
completion_criteria: Market documents state the covered period, latest available session, source, and any missing or delayed observations.

stages.objective: Derive filing-grounded financial metrics, trends, guidance, and transcript findings with period and unit lineage.
completion_criteria: Every reported metric identifies its source period and unit, and unresolved filing, guidance, or transcript gaps remain explicit.

stages.objective: Analyze material company events, peers, factors, and news using only evidence available by the cutoff.
completion_criteria: Material events and comparisons are evidence-linked, temporally valid, and distinguish observations from interpretation.

stages.objective: Audit claim grounding, counterevidence, source coverage, and point-in-time validity across the analysis.
completion_criteria: Each material claim is grounded or flagged, counterevidence and coverage gaps are recorded, and post-cutoff evidence is excluded.

stages.objective: Recalculate material numerical claims deterministically and reconcile units, scales, and periods.
completion_criteria: Each material calculation has reproducible inputs and method, with mismatches corrected or explicitly unresolved.

stages.objective: Construct the strongest evidence-bounded upside case without suppressing uncertainty or contrary evidence.
completion_criteria: The bull case states evidence-linked claims, key assumptions, invalidation conditions, and acknowledged counterevidence.

stages.objective: Challenge the bull case with the strongest evidence-bounded downside claims and counterevidence.
completion_criteria: The bear case addresses material bull claims and states evidence, assumptions, and invalidation conditions for each counterclaim.

stages.objective: Synthesize evidence and debate into explicit valuation scenarios with traceable assumptions.
completion_criteria: Valuation scenarios expose methods, assumptions, sensitivities, and limitations without presenting analytical scenarios as executable advice.

stages.objective: Identify material risk scenarios and sanitize any portfolio context to preserve the non-executable research boundary.
completion_criteria: Risks include triggers, impacts, mitigants, and evidence links, and no output grants trading or order authority.

stages.objective: Compare the point-in-time findings with eligible prior context and identify substantiated changes.
completion_criteria: Each reported delta names the comparable prior state, current evidence, effective date, and any unavailable comparison context.

stages.objective: Define observable conditions that would confirm, weaken, or invalidate the current research conclusions.
completion_criteria: Monitoring conditions specify the observable signal, relevant threshold or event, evidence source, and affected conclusion.

stages.objective: Evaluate the dossier for evidence, numerical, temporal, and completeness requirements before assembly.
completion_criteria: The evaluation records pass or fail for every required dimension and lists all unresolved blockers without fabricating completeness.

stages.objective: Assemble the validated company-research.v3 submission without changing its frozen contract or semantic content.
completion_criteria: The assembled submission satisfies the strict v3 contract, preserves explicit limitations, and contains no unsupported completion claims.

stages.objective: Translate dossier findings into falsifiable hypotheses with append-only lifecycle status.
completion_criteria: Each hypothesis states a testable claim, supporting basis, falsifier, observation plan, and current status.

stages.objective: Build restatement-aware fundamental series and ratios with reconciled units, scales, and lineage.
completion_criteria: Fundamental series and ratios are reproducible from cited inputs, preserve restatement lineage, and expose unresolved reconciliation gaps.

stages.objective: Produce deterministic DCF, reverse-DCF, comparable, and sensitivity outputs from explicit inputs.
completion_criteria: Every model records inputs, assumptions, method, sensitivities, and reproducible outputs, with unavailable inputs represented explicitly.

stages.objective: Normalize available consensus estimates and ratings and quantify revisions and dispersion.
completion_criteria: Consensus outputs identify source availability, normalization rules, covered periods, revisions, dispersion, and missing observations.

stages.objective: Analyze ownership, insider activity, and short interest as point-in-time positioning evidence.
completion_criteria: Positioning outputs state observation dates, source coverage, normalization choices, and explicit unavailable or stale evidence.

stages.objective: Cluster catalysts and events, assess materiality, and map dependencies without overstating causality.
completion_criteria: Each material cluster has evidence-linked events, timing, dependency relationships, materiality rationale, and uncertainty.

stages.objective: Specify a point-in-time, leakage-resistant experiment plan and a deterministic implementation digest for host execution.
completion_criteria: The plan defines dataset timing, purged walk-forward method, benchmark, metrics, resource budget, and reproducible implementation digest.

stages.objective: Execute the approved experiment in the host runtime within the declared resource budget and return receipts only.
completion_criteria: The host records the implementation digest, data cutoff, resource use, execution status, and output receipt, including explicit failure or unavailability.

stages.objective: Evaluate out-of-sample experiment results against the declared benchmark and hypotheses.
completion_criteria: Evaluation reports the declared metrics, benchmark comparison, uncertainty, limitations, and whether each tested hypothesis was supported or falsified.

stages.objective: Issue the research quality receipt, explicit forecasts, and reproducible calculation evidence for the completed work.
completion_criteria: The receipt applies every quality rule, links calculations and forecasts to evidence, and records failures or limitations without waiving them.

stages.objective: Validate and atomically publish the complete v4 submission and all required sidecars as a completed-only result.
completion_criteria: All terminal contracts validate together, all required artifacts are present, and publication occurs atomically only after complete validation.

routing_semantics.execution: The host executes stages with native agents or one sequential agent; the portable core never creates model clients.
routing_semantics.retrieval: Every capability is explicitly routed. Missing, denied, and unlicensed sources remain visible limitations.
routing_semantics.calculation: Decimal calculators and receipts are authoritative for arithmetic; model prose cannot replace them.
routing_semantics.experiments: Only manifests and receipts cross the boundary; generated executable code runs outside the portable process.
routing_semantics.publication: The v3 dossier and all sidecars become visible in one completed publication.
